brief:
Six Palestinians were killed and 38 others wounded in Israeli attacks across Gaza over the past 24 hours, the Gaza health ministry reported. The deaths and injuries occurred in separate incidents throughout the enclave, though the ministry did not specify the locations or circumstances of individual strikes.

The toll adds to the mounting casualties in Gaza amid ongoing hostilities in the region.
dek: Six Palestinians killed in 24 hours, Gaza health ministry reports Six Palestinians have been killed and 38 others wounded in Israeli attacks across Gaza in the last 24 hours, the enclave's health ministry reports.
title: Israeli attacks kill six Palestinians in Gaza within 24 hours
